abstract: Since 1974, in Chiba prefecture patients with trophoblastic disease have been registered with the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Chiba University School of Medicine as the registration and management center. An original follow-up system for postmolar patients has been used and following results obtained. From 1974 to 1981 (8 years), 1544 hydatidiform mole patients were registered. The number of deliveries was 582,641. The incidence of hydatidiform mole in deliveries was 1:377. Postmolar patients whose hCG titers were greater than 10,000 IU/l, 1,000 IU/l and 100 IU/l at the fifth, eighth and twelfth week respectively, were treated as trophoblastic sequelae. In these check points, 155 cases (10.0%) were treated as sequelae, namely, 9 cases (0.6%) of choriocarcinoma, 54 cases (3.5%) of invasive mole and 94 cases undetermined (6.1%). At the fifth week after molar evacuation, there were 96 cases whose hCG titers were from 1,000 to 10,000 IU/l, and at the eight week, 86 cases were from 100 to 1,000 IU/l. Among the former there were 30 cases (31.2%) and among the latter, 36 cases (41.9%) of spontaneous remission. By using this follow-up system, 66 cases (36.3%) were able to avoid over treatment.
abstract_ja: 1974年以降、千葉県では絨毛性疾患の患者を、千葉大学医学部産婦人科を登録・管理センターとして登録してきた。奇胎後患者に対する独自のフォローアップ体制を用い、以下の結果を得た。1974年から1981年（8年間）に1,544例の胞状奇胎患者が登録された。分娩数は582,641例であった。分娩における胞状奇胎の発生率は1:377であった。奇胎後患者のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が、5週、8週、12週時にそれぞれ10,000IU/l、1,000IU/l、100IU/lを超える場合を、絨毛性続発症として扱った。これらのチェックポイントにおいて155例（10.0%）が続発症として扱われ、そのうち9例（0.6%）が絨毛癌、54例（3.5%）が侵入奇胎、94例（6.1%）は判定不能であった。奇胎除去後5週目には、hCG値が1,000～10,000IU/lの患者が96例あり、8週目には、100～1,000IU/lの患者が86例あった。前者のうち30例（31.2%）、後者のうち36例（41.9%）が自然寛解した。このフォローアップ体制を用いることで、66例（36.3%）が過剰治療を回避できた。
